articleBodyHtml:
Introduction and Greetings

The stream begins with greetings and thank yous, indicating a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The speaker uses casual language, such as 'Um' and 'all right,' to start the conversation.

Weather Discussion

The speaker discusses the weather, noting that it is sunny and cold with wind. They mention that it is not too cold during the day due to the sun but becomes freezing once the sun sets and the wind picks up.

Upcoming Projects and Excitement

The speaker expresses excitement about their upcoming projects and mentions that their calendar is 'explosive.' They also note that someone (possibly a friend or colleague) was surprised by the amount of planning they had done in November and December.

Recognition and Rewards

The speaker is recognized for their hard work and is given time in Japan as a reward. They express gratitude for the opportunity and acknowledge the effort they put in throughout the year.

Solo Travel Tips in Japan

The speaker is asked for tips on solo travel in Japan. They suggest that it depends on the traveler's interests, such as shopping or other activities, and recommend trying a specific Japanese restaurant called Yayoi Ken.

Nickname Origin and Cultural References

The speaker explains that their nickname 'Yayoi' comes from a Japanese restaurant called Yayoi Ken. They mention that the nickname is also a reference to a deceased person named Ken and that they chose it because they do not know how to read the kanji for 'Yayoi.' They also describe it as a cute nickname.

Closing Remarks and Future Plans

The stream concludes with the speaker saying goodbye and leaving. They mention that they will be back later and provide details about their next stream, which will be at 8:30 PM JST and return around 11 PM JST. They also mention that they will take a picture of the new year's soup and post it on Twitter if it looks presentable.

Additional Notes

The speaker also mentions a watch-along event that will take place at 10:30 PM JST on their channel with other girls.
